text: Task 9: The Stadium Panorama (Projective - Homography) • Scenario: You have two photos from two different cameras covering a football field. They share a small overlapping area in the middle . Task: Select 4 matching points found in both images. Calculate the Homography matrix to mathematically project the second camera's view into the first camera's space, stitching them together into a seamless panorama. Task 10: The Master Forger (Full Hierarchy Challenge) • Scenario: You need to digitally insert a flat image of a painting into an empty, heavily angled picture frame hanging on a museum wall . Task: Traverse the entire hierarchy. Use a Linear Scale to shrink the painting, a Rigid Transformation to move it near the frame, and finally a Projective Transformation to warp the painting's 4 corners precisely into the 3D perspective of the angled frame . Talha Shahid 31 Page
